verdict.rationale: CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair axis for an on-device inference engine like Cactus, so this story applies. However, the evidence never mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any x86 SIMD optimization. It only says the local package runs on Linux, macOS and Windows on x86/x64 without a GPU, which shows the platform is supported but not that these instruction sets are used.
